title_en: The Runaway Train Engine - Caldecott Medal
source_file: 逃跑的小火车头-凯迪克奖（7-10岁）.pdf
full_text_zh:
[P1] 生命的故事:维吉尼亚作品集
逃跑的小火车头
[美]维吉尼亚·李·伯顿◎著绘 艾 柯◎译

[P2] CHOO CHOO
逃跑的
小火车头
[美] 维吉尼亚·李·伯顿◎著绘
艾柯◎译
天津出版传媒集团
百花文艺出版社

[P3] 送给
我的
儿子
阿瑞斯

[P4] 很久以前，
有一个小火车头，
她的名字叫突突。
突突非常漂亮，全身黑色，
闪闪发光。

[P5] 突突有一个汽笛，
经过岔道时，会发出“呜呜”声。

突突有一个铃铛，
到达车站时，会发出“叮当叮当”的声音。

[P6] 突突有个司机，名叫吉姆。
吉姆非常喜欢突突，
把她照顾得很好。
他把突突擦得亮亮的，
看上去就像新的一样，
给每个零件都上好油，让它们运转起来稳稳当当。
她还有一个刹车，
会发出不太好听的嘶嘶声。

[P7] 突突有个司炉工，他的名字叫欧力。
欧力给小火车头添加水和煤——
水和煤都装在燃料车里。
列车长叫阿奇波尔德，
他在车厢里走来走去，负责给乘客检票。
阿奇波尔德有一个大怀表，
到了出发的时间，他就会通知突突。

[P8] 突突拉着装满乘客的车厢，
还有装满行李和邮件的车厢，
再加上一节燃料车，
从小镇的小火车站，开到——

大城市的大火车站，然后再返回来。

突突越过平原……
又穿过公路，
这时，道口的栏杆会放下来。

[P9] 她在一一个又一个小站停留，
拉上乘客、行李和邮件，
继续开往大城市。
叮当！叮当！她又出发了。
穿过隧道，爬上山岭……

[P10] 驶下小山，穿过吊桥……
来到大城市的火车站。

[P11] 一天，突突自言自语：
“拉着这些笨重的车厢，真烦。
如果是我自己，一定跑得又快又轻松，
大家都会停下来看我，只看我自己！他们会说：
‘多机灵的小火车头啊！跑得真快！她真漂亮！
看呀，她一个人跑呢！’”
第二天，吉姆、欧力和阿奇波尔德
到餐馆去喝咖啡，
突突自己留在铁轨上。
“机会来了！”突突说着，就上路了。
突、突、突、突、突！
突、突、突、突、突、突！

[P12] 突、突、突、突！突、突、突、突！
叮当！叮当！呜——呜呜呜！
大家都停下来！大家都过来看看我、听听我！
突突一路疾驰穿过平原……
所有的牛、马和小鸡都吓坏了。
所有的人也吓坏了，
有的人还爬上了高塔。
突、突、突、突！
突、突、突、突！
突、突、突、突！
突、突、突！

[P13] 突突“轰隆轰隆”从铁道口飞驰而过。
所有的汽车、卡车都不得不赶紧踩刹车，
结果他们一辆叠一辆，撞成一片。
天哪！好可恶的小火车头！

[P14] 突突翻过一座座山岗，越开越快。
现在即使她想停下来，也不可能了。
糟了！前面吊桥还没放下！
突突跳了起来，刚好越过去。

[P15] 但是，
她的燃料车掉下去了。
幸好落在一艘
正从吊桥下经过的
运煤船上。

突突开到一座大城市的大停车场上。
嘶嘶——嘶嘶——
远处传来了特快列车的气动刹车声。
可怜的小火车头不知道该往哪儿走。
呀！那边有一条铁轨，
是环城的货运铁路。
突突往那条路逃去。

[P16] 开呀开，
突突出了城，
穿过郊区，
来到农村。天越来越黑，
她迷路了！
煤和水也不多了！
因为她丢了自己的
燃料车……
最后她来到一个
岔路口，
一条路向左，
一条路向右。
她不知道该走哪条路，
所以她选了
向左的那条。

[P17] 这是一条很旧的铁轨，
好多年没人用过了，
枕木间长满了灌木和杂草，
掉落的树枝铺满了轨道。
天几乎全黑了……
可怜的、疲倦的小火车头
来到了山顶……

突、突、突、突……
哧……突……突……突突突……
突突……突……哧哧……哧……哧！
哧——小火车头停下来了！

[P18] 吉姆、欧力和阿奇波尔德
听到小火车头开走的声音时，
都跳起来去追。
吉姆大叫：“停下！停下！”
但是突突已经跑远了，想听也听不到了。

[P19] 吉姆、欧力和阿奇波尔德跑啊跑啊，
直到再也跑不动了。
这时，一辆新式火车从他们身后开过来。
吉姆连忙掏出自己的红手绢
使劲挥舞。
新式火车停了下来。吉姆对车上的司机说：
“帮我去追逃跑的小火车头吧！
“那我的时刻表怎么办？”新式火车的司机说。
“别管你的时刻表啦！”吉姆说，“我必须找到突突。”
说着他爬了上去。
欧力和阿奇波尔德
也跟着爬上去。
吉姆驾着火车
飞快地跑起来！
他们出发了！

[P20] 很容易就知道
突突往哪个方向跑了——
所有的牛、马和小鸡
都用尾巴或头指着那个方向。
道口的人们也大叫：
“她往那条路走了！快把她带回来！'
镇子上的人也说：“快点！快点！
快去抓逃跑的小火车头，别让她再闯祸了！

[P21] 等待吊桥放下来时，
欧力大喊：“看呀！
燃料车在运煤船上。”
吉姆对欧力和阿奇波尔德说：
“你们在这儿把燃料车弄上来，
我去找突突。”
阿奇波尔德打电话找来起重机。
没多久，燃料车就被起重机吊上来，
放回铁轨上。
大家一起到大火车站的“停车场”前，
等着吉姆把突突带回来。

[P22] 吉姆和新式火车
终于来到了岔路口。
他们不知道
现在该走
哪条路。
正在商量时，
一位年轻时
当过工程师的老人
大声对他们说：
“你们是在找
逃跑的小火车头吗？
她往那边去了。
不过她开不了多远，
因为那条铁轨很旧了，
已经有四十年
没用过了。”

[P23] 他们打开车顶的大灯，
沿着旧铁轨慢慢走，
没走多远，
就看到了小火车头。
突突见到他们，真是太高兴了，
低低地鸣了一声“嘟”。
她就剩下一点点蒸汽了，
只够发出轻轻的汽笛声。
吉姆拿出一根大铁链，跑去拴在小火车头上。

[P24] 新式火车沿着旧铁轨
倒退着把小火车头拉回主轨道，
回到大城市，来到停车场——
欧力和阿奇波尔德正在那儿等着呢。
他们给突突挂上燃料车，把她开到圆形车库里，
给她做了全面检查，看看有没有受伤。
除了又脏又累，突突和原来一样健康！
小火车头回家了，吉姆、欧力和阿奇波尔德高兴地
跳起了快步舞。

[P25] 回家路上，突突对吉姆说：
“我再也不逃跑了，
一个人出去一点儿都不好玩。
我要拉着装满乘客和行李的车厢，
从小镇开到大城市，
再从大城市开回小镇。”
full_text_en:
[P1] Stories of Life: Virginia Collection
The Little Engine That Could
[US] Virginia Lee Burton ◎ Author and Illustrator, Ai Ke ◎ Translator

[P2] CHOO CHOO
The Runaway Train
[US] Virginia Lee Burton © Author and Illustrator
Ai Ke © Translator
Tianjin Publishing Media Group
Baihua Literature and Art Publishing House

[P3] To
my
son
Ares

[P4] Long ago,
there was a little train engine,
and her name was Tūtū.
Tūtū was very beautiful, all black,
shining brightly.

[P5] Tutu has a whistle,
which makes a "toot toot" sound when passing through a crossing.

Tutu has a bell,
which makes a "ding ding" sound when arriving at the station.

[P6] Tutu had a driver named Jim.
Jim really liked Tutu,
and took good care of her.
He polished Tutu until she shone,
looking as good as new,
and oiled every part so they ran smoothly.
She also had a brake,
which made a not-so-pleasant hissing sound.

[P7] Tutu has a fireman, and his name is Oli.
Oli adds water and coal to the little locomotive—
water and coal are stored in the fuel car.
The conductor is named Archibald.
He walks through the carriages, checking passengers' tickets.
Archibald has a big pocket watch.
When it's time to depart, he will notify Tutu.

[P8] Tutu pulls carriages full of passengers,
and carriages full of luggage and mail,
plus a fuel car,
from the small train station in the town, to——

the big train station in the big city, and then returns.

Tutu crosses the plain...
then crosses the road,
and at this time, the crossing barriers will come down.

[P9] She stopped at one small station after another,
loading passengers, luggage, and mail,
continuing on to the big city.
Clang! Clang! She set off again.
Through tunnels, up hills...

[P10] Rolling down the hill, crossing the suspension bridge...
Arriving at the big train station in the big city.

[P11] One day, Tootle muttered to herself:
"Pulling all these heavy carriages is such a nuisance.
If it were just me, I'd run fast and easy,
everyone would stop to look at me, just at me! They'd say:
'What a clever little engine! She's so fast! She's so beautiful!
Look, she's running all by herself!'

The next day, Jim, Ollie, and Archibald
went to the restaurant for coffee,
and Tootle was left alone on the tracks.
"My chance has come!" Tootle said, and set off.
Toot, toot, toot, toot, toot!
Toot, toot, toot, toot, toot, toot!

[P12] Choo, choo, choo, choo! Choo, choo, choo, choo!
Clang! Clang! Whoo—whoo-whoo!
Everyone stop! Everyone come and look at me, listen to me!
Tutu speeds across the plain...
All the cows, horses, and chicks are frightened.
Everyone is frightened too,
some even climbed up the tall tower.
Choo, choo, choo, choo!
Choo, choo, choo, choo!
Choo, choo, choo, choo!
Choo, choo, choo!

[P13] Tutu roared "Choo-choo" through the railroad crossing.
All the cars and trucks had to brake suddenly,
resulting in them piling up one on top of another, crashing into a heap.
Oh my! What a terrible little train engine!

[P14] Tutu rolled over hill after hill, speeding up.
Now, even if she wanted to stop, it was impossible.
Oh no! The drawbridge ahead hadn't been lowered!
Tutu jumped up and just barely made it across.

[P15] But,
her fuel car fell off.
Luckily, it landed on a
coal barge passing under the
lift bridge.

Tutu arrived at a big parking lot in a big city.
Sssss—sssss—
The sound of a fast train's air brakes came from afar.
The poor little engine didn't know which way to go.
Oh! There's a track over there,
it's the ring road freight railway.
Tutu fled down that path.

[P16] Chug, chug, chug,
Tutu left the city,
Passed through the suburbs,
And arrived in the countryside. The sky grew darker and darker,
She was lost!
Coal and water were running low!
Because she had lost her own
Fuel car……
Finally, she arrived at a
Railroad junction,
One track to the left,
One track to the right.
She didn't know which way to go,
So she chose
The one to the left.

[P17] This is an old railway track,
not used by anyone for many years,
with shrubs and weeds growing between the sleepers,
and fallen branches covering the rails.
The sky is almost completely dark...
The poor, tired little train engine
has reached the top of the hill...

Choo, choo, choo, choo...
Chuff... choo... choo... choochoo...
Choochoo... choo... chuffchuff... chuff... chuff!
Chuff—the little train engine has stopped!

[P18] Jim, Ollie, and Archibald
heard the sound of the little train leaving,
and all jumped up to chase after it.
Jim shouted: "Stop! Stop!"
But Toot had already run far away; they could no longer hear her.

[P19] Jim, Ollie, and Archibald ran and ran,
until they could run no more.
Then, a new-style train came from behind.
Jim quickly pulled out his red handkerchief
and waved it hard.
The new-style train stopped. Jim said to the driver:
"Help me chase the runaway little engine!"
"What about my schedule?" the driver of the new-style train said.
"Don't worry about your schedule!" Jim said, "I must find Tootle."
Saying that, he climbed up.
Ollie and Archibald
climbed up too.
Jim drove the train
and sped off!
They set off!

[P20] It was easy to know
which direction Toot-Toot had run—
all the cows, horses, and chicks
were pointing with their tails or heads.
The people at the crossing shouted:
“She went that way! Bring her back!'
The people in the town said: “Hurry! Hurry!
Go catch the runaway little train engine, don’t let her cause more trouble!”

[P21] While waiting for the drawbridge to lower,
Ollie shouted: "Look! The fuel car is on the coal barge."
Jim said to Ollie and Archibald:
"You two get the fuel car back up here,
I'll go find Toot."
Archibald called for a crane.
Soon, the fuel car was lifted by the crane
and placed back on the tracks.
Everyone gathered at the big train station's "parking lot",
waiting for Jim to bring Toot back.

[P22] Jim and the new train
finally arrived at a fork in the tracks.
They didn't know
which way to go.
While they were discussing,
a man who had been an engineer in his youth
shouted to them:
"Are you looking for
the runaway little train?
She went that way.
But she won't get far,
because that track is very old,
and hasn't been used for forty years."

[P23] They turned on the big light on top of the car,
and slowly walked along the old tracks.
Not far ahead,
they saw the little train.
Tutu was so happy to see them,
and softly whistled a little "toot".
She had only a tiny bit of steam left,
just enough to make a soft whistle sound.
Jim took out a big chain and ran to fasten it onto the little train.

[P24] The new train, traveling along the old tracks,
backed the little engine back onto the main line,
returning to the big city and arriving at the parking lot—
Ollie and Archibald were waiting there.
They attached the fuel car to Toot, took her to the roundhouse,
and gave her a full check-up to see if she was hurt.
Besides being dirty and tired, Toot was as healthy as ever!
The little engine was home, and Jim, Ollie, and Archibald happily
jumped into a quickstep dance.

[P25] On the way home, Toot said to Jim:
"I'll never run away again,
It's no fun going out alone.
I want to pull carriages full of passengers and luggage,
From the small town to the big city,
And then back from the big city to the small town."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《逃跑的小火车头》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息及一列正在行驶的火车插图。
[P2] 本页为绘本《逃跑的小火车头》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者及出版社信息，插图描绘了一列火车在轨道上疾驰，周围有动物和人物在奔跑或骑行，营造出紧张而动感的氛围。
[P3] 本页为绘本的献词页，文字内容为‘送给我的儿子阿瑞斯’，配图描绘了一个小男孩在轨道上玩耍，背景是多列火车在不同年代和场景中行驶的连续画面。
[P4] 本页介绍了故事的主角——一列名叫突突的小火车头，描述她非常漂亮、全身黑色且闪闪发光，并配有一幅她行驶在轨道上的插图。
[P5] 本页介绍了小火车头突突的两个声音特征：经过岔道时会鸣笛，到达车站时会响铃。
[P6] 本页介绍了小火车头突突的司机吉姆，他非常喜爱并精心照料突突，使其保持光亮和运转良好；同时提到突突的刹车会发出嘶嘶声。
[P7] 本页介绍了小火车头突突的两位工作人员：司炉工欧力负责为火车添加水和煤，列车长阿奇波尔德负责检票并在发车时通知突突。
[P8] 本页描述了小火车头突突的日常运行路线：从小镇火车站出发，拉着乘客、行李和燃料车，穿越平原和公路，前往大城市火车站，然后返回。插图展示了小镇、城市和铁路道口的场景。
[P9] 小火车头突突在沿途的小站停靠，装载乘客、行李和邮件，然后继续驶向大城市，途中穿过隧道和山岭。
[P10] 小火车头突突驶下小山，穿过吊桥，最终抵达大城市的火车站。
[P11] 突突因厌倦拉车厢而幻想独自奔跑，第二天趁工作人员去餐馆喝咖啡时，她独自上路，发出欢快的鸣笛声。
[P12] 小火车头突突独自疾驰穿过平原，发出响亮的鸣笛和车轮声，吓得沿途的牛、马、小鸡和人们纷纷躲避，有人甚至爬上了高塔。
[P13] 小火车头突突独自疾驰通过铁道口，导致所有车辆紧急刹车并发生连环碰撞，人们惊呼其可恶。
[P14] 小火车头突突在高速行驶中翻过山岗，发现前方吊桥未放下，她跳起并刚好越过桥梁。
[P15] 小火车头突突在越过吊桥时，燃料车掉落并落在一艘运煤船上。随后，她驶入大城市的一个大停车场，因不知去向而慌乱，最终发现并驶向一条环城货运铁路以逃避追捕。
[P16] 小火车头突突在逃离追捕后，因燃料耗尽而迷路，来到一个岔路口，面对左右两条路，她选择了向左的那条。
[P17] 小火车头突突在一条荒废的旧铁轨上行驶，因燃料耗尽而最终停在山顶，周围是长满杂草和树枝的废弃轨道。
[P18] 小火车头突突离开后，吉姆、欧力和阿奇波尔德听到声音立即追赶，但突突已跑远，他们追不上也听不见了。
[P19] 吉姆、欧力和阿奇波尔德追赶逃跑的小火车头突突，跑得筋疲力尽后，吉姆拦下一辆新式火车，请求司机帮忙追捕，三人爬上火车后，由吉姆驾驶，迅速出发追赶突突。
[P20] 画面描绘了小火车头突突疾驰而过，所有动物和人都指向她逃跑的方向，道口和镇上的人们纷纷大喊，要求尽快抓住她，防止她再闯祸。
[P21] 在吊桥放下时，欧力发现燃料车落在运煤船上，吉姆让欧力和阿奇波尔德负责取回燃料车，自己去追小火车头突突。阿奇波尔德呼叫起重机将燃料车吊回铁轨，众人则在大火车站的停车场等待吉姆带回突突。
[P22] 吉姆和新式火车在岔路口不知该走哪条路，一位曾是工程师的老人告诉他们逃跑的小火车头往哪边去了，并指出那条铁轨已废弃四十年，小火车头开不了多远。
[P23] 吉姆驾驶新式火车沿着废弃铁轨缓慢前行，很快找到了燃料耗尽、几乎停摆的小火车头突突。突突见到他们后非常高兴，发出微弱的汽笛声，吉姆随即拿出铁链准备将其拴住。
[P24] 新式火车将小火车头突突沿旧铁轨拉回主轨道，回到大城市停车场，欧力和阿奇波尔德已在等候。他们为突突挂上燃料车，带她到圆形车库检查，确认她健康无恙后，吉姆、欧力和阿奇波尔德高兴地跳起舞来。
[P25] 在回家的路上，小火车头突突向吉姆表示自己再也不逃跑，因为一个人出去并不好玩，她想拉满乘客和行李的车厢，在小镇和大城市之间往返运行。
[P26] 画面中，一辆小火车头在铁轨上行驶，烟囱冒出浓烟，背景有放射状线条表现速度感，车顶站着一个人影，整体呈现动态前进的场景。
